US.eyebrow: Travel Guide for United States Passport Holders
US.heading: What US Passport Holders Should Know Before Traveling

howItVaries.title: How Requirements Vary by Destination
howItVaries.body: Entry rules differ by destination and can change. This sample groups listed entries by their recorded status; it may be incomplete or out of date. Confirm the current requirements with the destination's official government source.

whatYouNeed.title: What You'll Typically Need
whatYouNeed.body: Passport-validity rules, supporting documents and application steps vary by destination and trip purpose. Check the official instructions for your itinerary before applying or traveling.

howWeHelp.title: Applying Through Visa Expeditor
howWeHelp.body: We help explain application forms and share status updates by email. Government authorities make all visa and entry decisions.
